newsitem.title: UK: Moorfield rules out merger with Greycoat.
newsitem.headline: Moorfield rules out merger with Greycoat.

text.p: British property group Moorfield Estates Plc said on Monday it would not proceed with an offer for property company Greycoat.

It said it had been unable to pursue constructive discussions with Greycoat relating to its merger proposal despite encouragement from shareholders holding a significant proportion of Greycoat shares.

"In the absence of a meaningful dialogue and reasonable exchange of information, Moorfield believes that the risks of acquiring Greycoat outweigh the benefits of the proposed merger," Greycoat said in a statement.

Moorfield said it will watch with interest Greycoat's implementation of its newly adopted strategy and the impact on net asset value, but it said will continue to pursue its own stated strategy, including opportunities to acquire or merge with other property companies.

Embattled Greycoat had the immediate threat of a shareholder call for its break-up removed on December 5 after an overwhelming vote against a break-up resolution put forward by the UK Active Value Fund (UKAV).
